description: This file contains unit tests for WebLink JSON communication in the WPEFramework project, including server and client classes, command parameter definitions, and test cases for JSON WebSocket interactions.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Represents command parameters with speed, duration, command type, and settings.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command with identifier, name, base address, trick flag, and parameters.

classes.name: JSONWebServer
classes.description: A WebSocket server handling JSON command requests and responses.

classes.name: JSONWebClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client for sending and receiving JSON command messages.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a CommandBody to incoming requests or responses.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket requests or responses, verifies content, and processes command data.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a response or request over WebSocket.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves received data into a string.
